title: A Buenos Aires books contributor takes it to air on Neura — 'la confianza es el activo más subestimado de los negocios'
summary: Balayan runs Maure Inmobiliaria in Buenos Aires and has a standing books slot on Neura, where she recommended Incorruptible on air. Her written summary tracks the book closely: financial gravity growing with investors and short-term return pressure, governance and legal structure as what fixes it, Costco and Patagonia as the examples.
blockquote: La idea más potente del libro es que la confianza es el activo más subestimado de los negocios.
